rules.title: Default branch is protected
remediation: Require the repository default branch to use reviewed branch protection or an equivalent ruleset where the provider and plan support it.

rules.title: Third-party workflow dependencies are immutable
remediation: Pin third-party GitHub Actions to full immutable commit SHAs or immutable digests and retain a human-readable version comment where practical.

rules.title: Workflows declare token permissions
remediation: Add explicit least-privilege top-level permissions to every GitHub Actions workflow.
